title: Lifting subobjects from a distinguished clopen return sheet
statement: Let k₁/k₀ be an extension of finite fields and ℓ invertible in both. Let X/k₀ be smooth and finite type and C/k₁ geometrically connected and finite type, with an open and closed immersion c:C→X commuting with structural maps [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let #k₁=(#k₀)^r. Let v:Cbar→Xbar have projection Cbar→C→X and closure projection given by the inverse fixed k₀-algebra isomorphism k₁bar≃k₀bar, and suppose Fr_C;v=v;Fr_X^r. Let P be the explicit powered pullback [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback]. For every lisse source Weil sheaf V and every lisse Weil sheaf G on C with a monomorphism i:G→P(V), there are a lisse source Weil sheaf U, a monomorphism j:U→V, and an isomorphism e:P(U)≃G such that P(j)=e.hom;i [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. No simplicity or nonzero-stalk assumption is made.

proof.text: Prove that v is an open and closed immersion from its two geometric projection equations. Form the explicit image of the free Frobenius algebra on v_! of the carrier of G. Its image inclusion is monic, and the canonical zero-th generator recovers the carrier map of i.

proof.text: The canonical generator is mono because its composite with the restricted image inclusion is the given mono. The cyclic return calculation proves it epi. Lift it through the equivariant monomorphism to a Weil isomorphism; equivariance follows by cancellation.

proof.text: Lissity of the explicit saturation follows from finite-rank stabilization of the countable sum of lisse translates. Thus it is constructible and defines U. Restrict the inclusion to constructible Weil categories using the canonical comparison. The inverse of the canonical generator gives e, and its proved factorization gives P(j)=e.hom;i.

theorem exists_lisse_subobject_clopen_return
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    [Algebra k₀ k₁] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [GeometricallyConnected (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))]
    [QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))]
    (c : C ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsClosedImmersion c]
    (hc : c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) =
      (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (v : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (hp : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c)
    (hb : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁).symm.toRingHom))
    (hv : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ v =
      v ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom)
    (V : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (hV : V.IsLisse)
    (G : WeilSheaf k₁ l C) (hG : G.IsLisse)
    (i : G ⟶ (poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj V) [Mono i] :
    ∃ (U : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (j : U ⟶ V), Mono j ∧ U.IsLisse ∧
      ∃ e : (poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj U ≅ G,
        (poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).map j = e.hom ≫ i
